log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"Show 2024 solar PV capacity additions in MW by market segment, country and quarter, with totals for each country-quarter.","tasks":["Find an addition value for a particular segment, country and quarter.","Compare Q1 with Q2 within a country and compare countries within or across regions.","Read across a segment or down a country-quarter column, including the total."],"relations":["Each region groups two countries; each country groups Q1 and Q2.","Each data cell connects a segment with one country and quarter; the total summarizes the segments above it."],"roles":["The first column identifies segments and the total.","Three header levels identify region, country and quarter.","The eight data columns contain comparable MW values."],"keep_whole":["Country and region names where their merged headers allow it.","Quarter labels, individual numbers and the words in segment names."],"may_wrap":["Multiword segment names at spaces; Commercial & industrial can use multiple lines."],"same_scale":["The eight quarter columns serve the same role and should remain broadly comparable in width.","Paired quarters within each country should have similar widths."],"h_vs_v":"The width limit requires segment labels to wrap. Giving the first column more space shortens rows but leaves the numeric columns close to their content minimum; giving it less space creates more vertical reading while allowing a more even data grid."},"designs":[{"widths":[144,61,61,54,59,59,59,49,59],"strategy":"Give the segment labels the most space, using content-sized numeric columns to limit row wrapping."},{"widths":[125,61,61,59,60,60,60,59,60],"strategy":"Balance label space with a nearly uniform quarter grid, accepting some wrapping in the first column."},{"widths":[107,65,65,62,62,62,62,60,60],"strategy":"Use a narrow segment column and a spacious, regularly scaled numeric grid to emphasize comparison across quarters and countries."}]}
